ecosystem_note.text: The operator map has consolidated fast: Adani (west and east coast private ports plus Vizhinjam), DP World and PSA (JNPA/Cochin/Chennai box terminals), APM Terminals (Pipavav) and JSW (captive-plus-third-party bulk). Equipment supply for new deepwater capacity is currently foreign-led (ZPMC cranes; European dredging majors), while Indian EPC presence in the largest marine works (Afcons breakwater; ITD Cementation dredging JV) is documented and growing. Shipbuilding capacity is concentrated in PSU yards (Cochin, GRSE, HSL, GSL) plus L&T Kattupalli.
